statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
These symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms have become more frequent despite current medical management
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a significant history of cerebral infarction
CPT 93271 was billed for this patient
The diagnosis codes I47.1 and Z86.73 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring via CPT 93271 is clinically necessary
The monitoring supports the diagnoses I47.1 and Z86.73
